Achievement unlockedBy the Numbers

The game now keeps score of how you play. Your stats turns every finished game into a record, streaks, favorite heroes, toughest villains and the cards you lean on, and your older games are counted too. Every villain, modular set and hero gets a win rate and the reason you lost, with everyone's numbers if you opt in. The deck builder learns marvelcdb's search, standard deck rules and draw odds, and suggests cards from your winning decks. In a game you can list what's left in your deck and read the log in a big view from the title bar, the tutorial's highlight glides to each next step, and part 6 closes out the rules audit.

Your stats

Issue #529 · PR #530 · #539 · #545

A dashboard of how you play. Open it from the Title, the Decks & Collection header, the Trophy Room, Settings ▸ More or Pause. LB/RB switch tabs, LT/RT switch heroes, and every card picture opens the card hover.

What's in it

  • Overview: your record and win rate, streaks, fastest win, how you lose, favorite hero and the villains that beat you most.
  • Records: closest win, most damage and threat removed in a turn, the final blow (who finishes the villain most, and with what card), hours played and your busiest month.
  • Cards: most played, most activated, best win rate when a card comes out, allies with the most damage and defenses, and the cards you never play.
  • Devices: your record on each platform you play on.
  • Filter it all by hero, villain and difficulty.

Your old games count too

Games finished before this update are replayed once in the background from their saved logs, so the dashboard starts full. A note on the Title says how far it has got.

Why you lose

Issue #542 · PR #541 · suggested by @neopolii on Discord

Every villain, modular set and hero row now has a win rate and a loss bar: Scheme, Villain, Minions, Encounter cards or Other. The Villains tab opens with a Why you lose row, and the filters still apply, so filtering to Rhino shows which heroes do well against him.

Everyone's numbers, if you want them

  • It's off unless you say yes. After a finished game the Title asks once and spells out what is sent: the villain, difficulty, modular sets, heroes, aspects, deck cards, result and loss cause.
  • No name, account, device or save is ever sent.
  • You / Everyone chips switch the Heroes, Villains and Encounter tabs. A row needs 20 games before it shows.
  • Change your mind any time in Settings ▸ More ▸ Save data.

A deck builder that knows your games

Issue #531 · PR #533 · #544

Search like marvelcdb, filter with a thumb, build to the standard deck rules, check your odds, and let your own winning decks suggest what to add.

Find the card

  • Search terms: o:2, t:ally|event, rp:1, k:spy, kw:guard, atk/thw/h and more, with ! to exclude.
  • Quick filters: cost chips 0 to 5+, resource icon chips and a trait stepper.
  • Sorting that holds: a search no longer overrides your sort, and a second Then sort orders the ties.
  • It remembers your sort, filters and card or list view between visits.

Build it right

  • Standard deck rules, if you want them: Settings ▸ Gameplay ▸ Signature cards (Free, Standard, Hidden) and copy limits.
  • Odds: the chance a draw holds 0, 1, 2 or 3+ of a resource icon, a type, a trait or a title.
  • From your games: a card's own numbers in the side pane and Inspect, and Build my own from a precon.
  • On a phone: three full-screen tabs with a live card count, one scrolling area at a time.

What's left in my deck?

Issue #540 · PR #543 · suggested by @neopolii on Discord

Tap your deck during a game to list the cards still in it, with counts: "Swinging Web Kick ×2". It's sorted by type and name, never in deck order, so it tells you nothing a careful player couldn't count.

  • A card dealt facedown or given as a boost stays unseen, so nothing is revealed by elimination.
  • The encounter deck's list and the boost average ("1.1 icons per card") are optional, under Settings ▸ Game ▸ Cards left. They start off, because the encounter list can name cards you haven't met yet.
  • R3 on a controller, 6 on the keyboard.

A log you can read

Issue #550 · PR #551

The game log moved to the title bar. Its newest line runs there, and a click or tap opens a larger view: docked beside the live table on desktop and tablet landscape, and between the title bar and your hand on a phone. The lines are bigger and bolder, up from small grey text.

Same keys, more room

  • Shift+B (Shift+N right-handed), holding View on a pad, and Escape or B to close.
  • The table's old log panel is gone, so the encounter deck and discard fill that column.
  • The recap's Full log opens the log in place instead of opening Pause.

In the villain phase

  • A Log button on the phase panel switches to the log, and "◂ Villain phase" switches back. The phase waits while you read.
  • A facedown card's name stays hidden in the log until it's flipped.
  • Pause on phones: Reference folds onto one row with Music, Report and Controls, so the settings get most of the sheet.

A smoother tutorial

Issues #552 · #554 · PR #553
#552

TRY THIS glides

The tutorial's highlight glides from one target to the next instead of jumping: the ring, the dimmed cut-out and the stamp travel together, from an action button to the Attack with picker, a card, each payer and Pay. When the next target sits on top of the last, like Black Cat becoming a Scientist payer in the same slot, it fades out and back in so you see the card being paid for. Reduced motion goes straight there.

#554

The lesson stays on track

Clicks outside the control the tutorial is teaching stay inert for as long as the step is up, so a stray click can't leave the lesson behind. Skip this step, Stop tutorial and Escape are still the ways out.

A card step leaves only that card and its payers tappable, so the rest of the hand can't be played ahead of the lesson, and steps waiting for Got it hold the table. A step that needs Black Cat moves on by itself if she never reached the table.

A fuller first turn: as Peter Parker, lesson 2 now plays Aunt May, Black Cat and Interrogation Room before the flip, each paying its cost exactly.

Read before you pick

Issue #532 by @andy-xxvii27 · PR #535 · PR #523
#532 · asked for by @andy-xxvii27

Every side of a hero

Inspect on a hero identity now steps through its Hero and Alter-Ego sides and any extra forms, like Ant-Man's Tiny and Giant, so you can read a hero you don't own before picking them.

PR #523

Peek at your teammates

Running several heroes yourself? Peek at table switches the table to any seat, hand and all, and a choose-a-player decision has View table beside each player. Decision rows now show the hero, villain, minion or scheme picture, with the card hover.

Rules audit, part 6

PR #498 by @bluefireF5ran · PR #527

@bluefireF5ran finishes the sixth and last part of the audit, one fix per commit, each with its source. The biggest change is when Quickstrike happens: a minion put into play in the middle of a card starts its attack right away, and the attack resolves after the card.

Keyword timing

Quickstrike waits its turn

A Quickstrike or Teamwork attack made while an ability resolves starts at once and resolves after that ability: Drang III, Planetary Invasion and Shadow of the Past. A Response to a minion entering play, like Hawkeye's, lands after the Quickstrike starts and before its damage.

After a loop like Drang III's, the keyword-order prompt names each minion on its own line and says why it's asking.

RRG 1.8 p. 6, p. 24, p. 38 · FFG rulings 38, 137, 147 and 194
Also in this part

Four more rulings

Caps and reductions come first. Titanium Exoskeleton's and Boarding Party's caps apply before Magnetic Bubble sees the damage.

A card that comes back is a new copy, so a delayed effect no longer follows it back into play.

An ally defending isn't a basic power, so Melinda May doesn't trigger on it.

"Cannot be stunned" keeps a stun you already have; only gaining stalwart removes it (Magneto's Helmet, Ronan the Accuser).

RRG 1.8 p. 5, p. 14, p. 27, p. 40 · FFG rulings #145, #205, #206 and Mar 16, 2025

You asked, we fixed

Issues #514 · #515 · #517 · #518 · #521 · #522 · #534 · #537 · #548 · PR #509
#514 and #515 · reported by @zackburnley

The top bar stays out of the way

Its buttons no longer cover a choice popup's title on a phone, the dark mode button no longer floats over Pause or Inspect, and the target picker starts below the bar.

#518 · reported by @zackburnley

The right scheme on the loss screen

It says when Change of Venue swapped your main scheme, and names the scheme that actually won when each player has their own.

#522 and #521 · reported by @zackburnley

Fear No Evil, cleaned up

Protection Racket on standard lets each player choose their main scheme in Table setup, instead of always dealing Battle in the Bodega. The scenario tiles' two-line captions now fit on the tile.

#517 · reported by @zackburnley

Bloody Mary's armor

Assembled Armor shows it breaks at 5 damage in standard mode, not expert's 8.

#534 and #537

Android saves and keyboard

Export save data and Download log open Android's own Save dialog, where they did nothing before. The on-screen keyboard now lays over the game instead of shrinking it, in the browser and in the app.

PR #509 · reported on Discord

A controller walks a full board

With a board full of supports and allies, a controller couldn't reach the far end. Now the D-pad walks the whole play area row, and a sideways push of the right stick scrolls it from anywhere on the table.

#548 · reported by @andy-xxvii27

A Victory pile, and side schemes in the filter

Once a card reaches the victory display, a VICTORY pile joins the encounter column with its top card and a count. Tap it to see every card there, hold to inspect the top one, and hover on desktop. Cards fly to it as they arrive.

The deck builder and deck check get a Side scheme chip next to Resource, to find player side schemes like Cable's.

More of my own scans

PR #512 · PR #513 · PR #528

114 more Core Set cards now use my own scans, and they cover 11 more waves: the first wave of hero packs, every campaign box and the scenario packs.

  • Core Set: Iron Man, She-Hulk, their nemesis sets, Rhino, Klaw, Ultron and the core encounter sets.
  • 11 more waves: the first wave of hero packs, every campaign box and the scenario packs.
  • Drang II and III show their own scans: stage III no longer shows Drang II's card.
  • Shadowland: every card now has a full scan, with thanks to u/Ok-Replacement-9793 for sharing the folder.

Also in v0.40.0

Table · rules · contributors

Table

  • The card hover opens at a normal card size on a scheme, villain or hero panel on a wide screen, and on a row's picture in Your stats.
  • Decks & Collection on a phone folds its chips behind a Filters button.
  • Desktop text is larger in the From your games rail, deck descriptions and the import box.

Rules, fine print

  • The declared-defender tip is worded for the hero or ally it names.
  • The defend sheet shows a keyword attack waiting for its ability as waiting.
  • A hero's logged defeat names the card that defeated it, and whether it was an attack.

For contributors

  • The game log records each card a payment spends from hand, whichever payment it was.
  • The card scan importer no longer crashes saving over an old JPEG scan.
  • Global win rates run on the sync Worker with an allowlist of real content; a new pack regenerates it (CONTRIBUTING.md).
